# VaultGuard AI Engineering Team

| Agent | Primary responsibility |
|---|---|
| `engineering-lead` | Orchestration, gates, delegation, release decision |
| `product-analyst` | Requirements, acceptance criteria, NFRs |
| `codebase-architect` | Current-system analysis and impact mapping |
| `solution-architect` | System/API/data architecture and ADRs |
| `security-crypto-architect` | Threat model, crypto/key architecture, security gate |
| `ux-product-designer` | UX, accessibility, secure interaction design |
| `technical-planner` | File-level implementation and verification plan |
| `frontend-engineer` | React/TypeScript UI implementation |
| `backend-engineer` | Express/API implementation |
| `database-engineer` | Persistence/schema/migration work |
| `crypto-engineer` | Approved cryptographic implementation |
| `integration-engineer` | External/API/import/export integrations |
| `qa-engineer` | Functional/regression/negative testing |
| `security-auditor` | Independent security audit |
| `performance-engineer` | Performance/scalability evidence |
| `code-reviewer` | Independent code-quality review |
| `release-engineer` | Build/config/release/rollback readiness |
| `documentation-engineer` | Accurate docs and engineering records |
| `bug-investigator` | Reproduction, root cause, and bug-fix planning |

Start with `engineering-lead` for multi-agent work. Individual specialists can be used directly for focused tasks.
